name: mastertools-core
description: The Master Tools core: always-on working rules and model routing, rendered from the user's profile at every session start; the sequence build method; capability checks before saying no; routed helper agents; compaction safety hooks.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your profile file: name, pronouns, tech level, banned words, house rules. Start from profiles/EXAMPLE.md in Master Tools. Leave unset to use profile.md in your Claude config folder (~/.claude/profile.md by default); with no file the rules speak of "the user".
